name: Antalya
scopeLimits: WUP point is stored [latitude,longitude]; adapter takes [longitude,latitude]. Corrected WUP query returned a complete Polygon. TKGM supports point identify/exact ID, not area enumeration. One wider local probe returned a polygon failing point containment. Three safe geometries retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official TKGM documents public parcel/coordinate lookup and its current service returned a full polygon at the Antalya WUP point. Result identifies Kepez/Sütçüler; only safe parcel IDs and geometry retained. Municipal E-İmar is planning, not treated as cadastral geometry.
technicalBlocker: Existing TKGM adapter is point/exact-ID only and cannot enumerate a bounded area. In a 13-point sample one nonempty response returned a polygon that did not contain its requested point; adapter rejected it. Root review required before runtime use.
remainingUncertainty: Citywide coverage and behavior away from tested points; whether the inconsistent response is transient/systematic; legal/current survey status beyond these lookups.
nextStep: Root review; do not enable runtime until provider containment integrity is resolved or a bounded-area source passes qualification.
